title: UsageImpactGroupFactor - Data API
description: Represents a junction between an Usage Impact Group version and Usage Impact Factor. This object is available in API version 58.0 and later.

FactorValue.description: Defines the value of the Usage Impact Group Factor.

IsActive.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsActive.description: Indicates whether the Usage Impact Group Factor is active. The default value is false.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: The name of the Usage Impact Group Factor.

UnitOfMeasureId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
UnitOfMeasureId.description: The UnitOfMeasure object associated with the Usage Impact Group Factor. This field is a relationship field.

UsageImpactFactorId.description: The Usage Impact Factor object associated with the Usage Impact Group Factor. This field is a relationship field.

UsageImpactGroupVersionId.description: The Usage Impact Group Version object associated with the Usage Impact Group Factor. This field is a relationship field.
